1,000,000 base vectors · 10,000 queries · 128 dimensions · T=1, M=16, efConstruction=500

Historical run: 16 physical build cores, one NUMA socket, no interleave; same GCC 14.3 -O3 and OpenCV/Eigen/zlib, OpenCV 1 thread.
